note: Hand-written expectations for the extraction distinctions the output must make. Each check is grounded in a section of the official React 18 upgrade guide (react.dev/blog/2022/03/08/react-18-upgrade-guide), the React v18.0 release post, or CHANGELOG.md. Regexes match path names, descriptions, condition statements, expected values, search patterns and migration steps, not evidence quotes.

checks.source: Upgrade guide, Deprecations: ReactDOM.render has been deprecated. Using it will warn and run your app in React 17 mode.
Upgrade guide, Deprecations: render, hydrate, unmountComponentAtNode and renderToNodeStream are deprecated independently.
Upgrade guide, Updates to Client Rendering APIs: We've also removed the callback from render.
Upgrade guide, Automatic Batching: all updates will be automatically batched, no matter where they originate from.
Upgrade guide, Other Breaking Changes: hydration mismatches are now treated like errors instead of warnings.
Upgrade guide, Dropping Support for Internet Explorer.
Upgrade guide, Updates to TypeScript definitions: update your @types/react and @types/react-dom dependencies.
Upgrade guide, Configuring Your Testing Environment: set globalThis.IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT to true.
Upgrade guide, Updates to Client Rendering APIs: replace render with createRoot from react-dom/client.
Upgrade guide: We've also changed unmountComponentAtNode to root.unmount.
Upgrade guide, Note: For React Native users, React 18 will ship in a future version of React Native.
Upgrade guide: If you need to support Internet Explorer we recommend you stay with React 17.
